name: nds
statement: The Nintendo DS as the arcade lists it: its cartridges are found and described, but no player is built yet. The DS machine card (machine/nds) runs both CPUs on the ARM instruction cards and boots games through their start-up code; the picture, sound and input hardware have no cards yet, and its coverage report (cardmodel machine nds ROM) is the work queue.
playable_note: Not playable yet: the DS machine boots it on the ARM instruction cards (both CPUs, every BIOS call it makes) but has no 2D/3D picture, sound or input yet.
title: Nintendo DS
